logger.doc:name: Log PATCH Orders Request
logger.message: #[%dw 2.0 output application/json --- { appName: app.name, flowName: flow.name, message: "PATCH orders request received.", correlationId: vars.correlationId, timestamp: now() }]

db:update.doc:name: Update Order Sync Status
db:update.db:sql: UPDATE ordersStaging SET syncStatus = :syncStatus, syncMessage = :syncMessage, salesforceId = :salesforceId, updatedAt = NOW() WHERE orderId = :orderId
db:update.db:input-parameters:
#[{ orderId: payload.orderId,
syncStatus: payload.syncStatus,
syncMessage: if(payload.syncStatus == "SUCCESS") "Orders synced successfully to Salesforce." else "Orders sync failed.",
salesforceId: if(payload.syncStatus == "SUCCESS") "SF-" ++ (now() as String {format: "yyyyMMddHHmmss"}) else null }]

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 output application/json --- { success: false, message: "Order not found.", correlationId: vars.correlationId, timestamp: now() }

logger.doc:name: Order Not Found Response
logger.message: #[%dw 2.0 output application/json --- { appName: app.name, flowName: flow.name, message: "PATCH failed. Order not found.", correlationId: vars.correlationId, timestamp: now() }]

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 output application/json --- { success: true, message: "Orders sync status updated successfully.", correlationId: vars.correlationId, timestamp: now() }

logger.doc:name: Patch Orders Response Sent
logger.message: #[%dw 2.0 output application/json --- { appName: app.name, flowName: flow.name, message: "PATCH orders response sent successfully.", correlationId: vars.correlationId, timestamp: now() }]
